source: TAT-2 expansion content built from the shipped Skybox distant-building kit
notes: KF11's mission-preparation frame stands the thief on a slate ridge with the Kilcairn skyline behind him. The two loaded lobby sublevels (MissionLobby_Geo3 + MissionLobby_Periphery) only carry nine DistantBuildingC blocks, all west of the framed stage and hidden by the Periphery storefront wall.

This file is original TAT-2 layout data, not extracted content: it places shipped Skybox meshes/materials (/Game/Art/Environment/Skybox/...) in a stage-relative ring. The runtime never rewrites the authored sublevels.

Placement is camera-relative so a reframe keeps the composition: azimuth_deg is measured from the prep camera's horizontal forward (+ = left, matching Godot's +Y rotation), distance_m is the horizontal metres, base_y is the world Y of the mesh AABB bottom (the shipped skyline meshes sit on y=0), yaw_deg is the node's Y rotation, scale is uniform.

The 11.33 deg vertical prep lens sees ~0.09 m of height per metre of distance; DistantBuildingC is 24.4 m tall at scale 1, so the roofline band needs ~300-500 m standoff and a >1 scale to read above the ridge without eating the frame.
layer is documentation only: near = KF11 foreground mass, mid = the roofline band, far = the horizon row behind it.
